title: NORTHERN TRUST CORP 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: Northern Trust Corporation filed a Form 8-K on April 22, 2026, disclosing the results of its 2026 annual stockholders meeting held April 21, 2026. All voting matters passed: 13 director nominees were elected, the 2025 executive compensation advisory vote was approved, the 2026 Employee Stock Purchase Plan was approved, and KPMG LLP was ratified as independent auditor. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: All 13 director nominees were elected to the Board of Directors.
Advisory vote on 2025 named executive officer compensation was approved (148,700,308 for vs 9,443,599 against).
2026 Employee Stock Purchase Plan was approved (158,350,319 for vs 429,173 against).
KPMG LLP appointment as independent auditor for 2026 fiscal year was ratified (160,991,571 for vs 7,843,560 against).
Stockholders representing 168,937,566 shares (91.15% of common stock) voted, indicating strong participation.
This filing is Item 5.07 (Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders) and Item 9.01 (Financial Statements and Exhibits).
